description: EtcdSnapshot is one encrypted etcd snapshot of a TalosCluster. The backup policy creates one per schedule; pk-metal backup now creates one at once. Deleting the object does not delete the stored bytes; retention deletes both.

fields.name: spec
fields.description: EtcdSnapshotSpec names the policy a snapshot is taken under: its sink and recipients.

fields.name: policyRef
fields.description: PolicyRef names the EtcdBackupPolicy.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the object.

fields.name: status
fields.description: EtcdSnapshotStatus records one snapshot. The object is the catalogue entry; the bytes live in the sink, at Location.

fields.name: clusterName
fields.description: ClusterName is the TalosCluster, copied from the policy when taken.

fields.name: conditions
fields.description: Conditions: Complete (True once stored; False when taking it failed, which is final: the next schedule takes a new one) and Verified (the plaintext is an intact etcd snapshot and the sink holds exactly the ciphertext sent).

fields.name: lastTransitionTime
fields.description: The time of the last change of the status.

fields.name: message
fields.description: A message for people about the last change. It can be empty.

fields.name: observedGeneration
fields.description: The generation of the object that the condition is for. A lower value than metadata.generation shows an old condition.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: A word in CamelCase that tells why the condition has its status.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The status of the condition: True, False or Unknown.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The type of the condition.

fields.name: databaseTxID
fields.description: DatabaseTxID is the bbolt transaction id of the database's newest meta page, and PageSize its page size: read off the snapshot as it passed, as evidence that it is a bbolt database.

fields.name: encryptedSize
fields.description: EncryptedSize and EncryptedSHA256 describe the object in the sink.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Location is where the ciphertext is (s3://bucket/key, pvc://claim/key), and Key its key in the sink.

fields.name: raftIndex
fields.description: RaftIndex is the member's raft index just before the snapshot: the snapshot holds at least everything up to it.

fields.name: recipients
fields.description: Recipients are the age public keys it was encrypted to.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Size and SHA256 describe the plaintext snapshot (the bbolt database and etcd's 32-byte integrity hash after it): what a restore uploads. pk-metal restore checks the decrypted bytes against SHA256.

fields.name: takenAt
fields.description: TakenAt is when the snapshot was started.

fields.name: takenFrom
fields.description: TakenFrom is the control-plane TalosNode whose etcd member streamed it, and MemberID that member's ID (hex).
